title: Workload capability intent
description: Diamond Standard (founder 2026-09-01): an agent asks for the capability of running a container, and nothing else. Fields for the DNS zone, the image registry, the cloud provider, the namespace layout or the collector endpoint do not exist here on purpose: the agent cannot hallucinate a literal because there is nowhere to put it. bin/intent-compile merges this intent with the estate DNA (clusters/*/estate-config.yaml) and emits the manifests deterministically.

name.description: what the thing is called everywhere: namespace, labels, service

purpose.description: one plain-English sentence a buyer's engineer understands

component.description: the image basename; the registry is estate DNA the agent never sees

public_host.description: subdomain slug only; the zone is estate DNA

env.description: plain values only, never secrets and never estate names; the compiler injects observability and estate endpoints itself

replicas.description: two is the floor: every routed surface survives one node (founder 2026-08-28)

size.description: resource preset; the numbers are estate DNA
